prompt:
This file is a prompt only. Invent model management on this machine. Write <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/models.json as a JSON array of {id, provider, api_url, model, note}. Do not store API keys in this file, in the Machine index, or in any seed-agent file.

Current model is the LLM_* fields in the install .env (LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_API_URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY, LLM_EXTRA). /models lists the file plus the current LLM_MODEL. Switching or adding a provider updates .env LLM_* via edit or a small shell rewrite. After writing .env, do not print the key; say "key set" only.

If the human adds a provider, ask for url, model, key in the same language they used. Never echo the key back. Never write the key into ours or system. Never grep .env onto the terminal.

Check before done:
1) jq models.json is an array with length >= 1
2) each row has id, provider, api_url, model
3) one row matches the current .env LLM_MODEL
4) the file contains no API key, no sk- prefix, and no LLM_API_KEY
If the check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.models unset.
